nodes.label: W-258 — Phase 2 worked: nine items measured, seven seated
nodes.rationale: Each item measured against the volumes, the witness or the seated resolver before anything was written; none taken from the docket's description of itself.

nodes.label: Register 1858 — a dependence claim keeps its result and loses its identification
nodes.rationale: The compendium defines charge as the ionisation stage and prints Nₑ = Z − charge + 1; Z − charge is a bijection with the electron count, so the function is the same function — it is simply not the electron count.

nodes.label: Register 1859 — the witness refutes an account of what was there before
nodes.rationale: The witness carries F.3.1 and F.3.2 as headings and references §F.3.1 twice in its own prose. The renumbering is not disturbed; only its claim that they never existed falls — and the witness that refutes it is the one Ruling 56 seats.

nodes.label: Register 1860 — a pointer that reaches neither entry
nodes.rationale: 286 has no heading of its own and is seated inside a group about misplacement, not miscounting; the entries that actually carry and close the finding are 289 and 290.

nodes.label: Register 1861 — two sites, one pointer, an entry about something else
nodes.rationale: The second citation takes 230 across seven, so the ≥ 7 table gains a row by hand at this build — which the build instrument refuses to write on its own.

nodes.label: Register 1862 — the LB column's 5 held nowhere
nodes.rationale: The Register holds every other figure of Λ₈'s row and not the one number saying what could not have been bettered without the exact answer. A gap in the record, not a defect in the table.

nodes.label: Register 1863 — the cited-but-absent class moved rather than shrank
nodes.rationale: The docket names six; measured by the seated resolver the cited absences are four and only one is on the docket's list. The other five are absent and cited by nothing, which the resolver's own rule declines to call a failure.

nodes.label: Register 1864 — the word Λ read one way before the caps and another after
nodes.rationale: 2n² sums ℓ from 0 to n − 1, the unbounded shell lattice, while Λ as seated caps ℓ and admits only n = 1, 2, 3. Both genesis entries' arithmetic is right for the object they describe.
